The '''OT-12 Pacification Droid''' was a large, multi-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A number of OT-12 Pacification Droids were among the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]] stationed on the [[Gorinth Plateau]].
